acceptance_criteria.F-001: No caller-controlled completion bypass; governed completion requires a durable accepted signed-verdict receipt bound to the authority task.
acceptance_criteria.F-002: Detached Ed25519 verdict verification binds exact task, authority task, audit checkpoint, candidate tree, contract, evidence manifest, dossier, producer, reviewer, model, effort, signer, and freshness.
acceptance_criteria.F-003: Auditor and closer model processes have attenuated tool schemas and dispatch guards; auditor reads are confined to a materialized non-writable candidate snapshot.
acceptance_criteria.F-004: Every subprocess waits on a controller-owned start gate until durable PID ownership is recorded; persistence failure terminates and waits for the child.
acceptance_criteria.F-005: Legacy rows migrate audit classification as null/UNKNOWN and fail closed until explicit classification.
acceptance_criteria.F-006: Checkpoint state has a durable content-addressed manifest/object set, actual bounded restoration, explicit ignored-path inclusion, and refusal to delete unbound new data.
acceptance_criteria.F-007: This task-bound contract, signed-verdict schema, evidence manifest, and machine-readable test evidence are candidate bytes and are embedded byte-verbatim in the dossier.
acceptance_criteria.F-008: The dossier includes exact commands, complete focused output, full-suite exploration result, and artifact digests rather than summary-only claims.

required_verification: Python compile check for changed Python files
deterministic candidate tree computed twice with a temporary index

audit.fallback_condition: Codex High is permitted only after the Fable 5 transport returns a provider-capacity exhaustion classification; a substantive Fable FAIL must never be replaced by fallback review.
